title: CST-DUST Erweiterungsstabilitaet v0.1
fixed: same named past/future nodes, all past-to-inner and inner-to-future relations, same collar preparation, H3 sections, positive normalization, Fresnel rule and q7 detector as PR 294
lift: in the chain and one-edge base orders add a fourth inner event 11, incomparable to 4,5,6, above every past and below every future node; fixed outer clocks, same normalized independent inner clock/density measure
sensitivity: also test every singleton addition to F2, and paired N12 additions to F2 independent of F4/F5 status
weights: equal positive amplitude per unlabelled interior isomorphism type in each support, normalized to sum 1, zero weights in embedded support recover the parent; this extends 1/2,1/2 and entails renormalization
admissibility: apply the inherited scalar boundary rigging, positive magnitude and action phase. Remove pure redundant gauge volumes only with specified parent gauge justification. Require full-rank reduced canonical graph and both symplectic pairings. Report an obstruction when these fail; never drop an inadmissible member to score a stage.
primary: equal-phase two-lobe preparation; densities 1/8 and 1/4, use unconditional four-outcome distributions
metric_absolute: at each density, TV(p_family,p_F2) <= 0.10 times F2 success at that density; compare to original anchor and also report consecutive changes when valid
metric_contrast: half-L1 change in the signed four-outcome density contrast <= 0.25 times half-L1 of the F2 contrast; same nonzero sign of success change required
scope: exploratory engineering tolerances fixed before numerical results; no claim of physical weight selection or infinite-size convergence
